claim: The CLI demo writes bundled JSON and a print-ready HTML report.
sandbox: fresh checkout; run the CLI demo; parse report.json and assert report.html plus all three checks

claim: The CLI demo uses bundled sample data in a temporary folder without a network dependency.
sandbox: fresh checkout; run the compiled demo behind failing proxy variables; assert its local files

claim: The web and CLI demos use the same bundled sample.
sandbox: fresh checkout; compare the web sample fields with the CLI demo report fixture

claim: The CLI makes no network request and sends no telemetry.
where: Landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: inspect the Rust source and complete dependency tree for network or telemetry clients

claim: Reports are written as JSON and print-ready HTML to the local output directory.
sandbox: Rust fixture writes a report to a temporary chosen directory and asserts both output files

claim: The test never changes clock, voltage, or driver settings.
sandbox: inspect every process command in the CLI for clock, voltage, power, driver, overclock, or vendor-setting commands

claim: Windows and macOS packages are unsigned.
sandbox: inspect the release workflow for unsigned package creation and absence of signing commands

claim: The core test runs locally with no account.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter the demo without credentials or account storage and run the local CLI demo

claim: A real GPU run requires explicit --yes consent.
sandbox: invoke a real run without consent and assert it stops before opening an adapter

claim: The inspect command lists the adapters and VRAM values visible on the host where it runs.
sandbox: run inspect and inspect --json on this sandbox host; parse the local inventory without supplying a GPU fixture or making a network request

claim: A report shows a coverage value only after all three patterns complete in that run.
where: Sample report note, report HTML, README
sandbox: run the controlled report fixture; assert coverage for three completed patterns and no coverage for an incomplete report

claim: The selected-adapter safety guard rejects missing temperature data and handles 85°C or a disappearing reading.
sandbox: run Rust safety fixtures with missing, safe, hot, multi-GPU, and disappearing selected-adapter telemetry

claim: A time or thermal stop saves an incomplete JSON and HTML report before exit.
sandbox: write a controlled stopped-run fixture; parse the saved JSON verdict and assert the printable HTML exists

claim: A failed memory check exits with code 2.
sandbox: feed a controlled mismatching completed pattern to the run outcome mapper and assert exit code 2

claim: The shell installer verifies SHA-256 before placing the binary on PATH.
sandbox: serve a fixture release archive and checksum locally; run installer; assert installed bytes

claim: The landing page selects a published archive for the visitor's platform.
sandbox: mock GitHub's CORS API with a Windows release and assert the rendered asset URL and version

claim: The demo page works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo; wait for service worker; go offline and reload

claim: The browser demo uses sample data and makes only same-origin requests.
sandbox: fresh browser with a real-license sentinel; capture the entire demo request stream

claim: The sample-data action is fully visible in the first 390 by 844 mobile screen.
sandbox: fresh 390 by 844 browser context; assert the complete primary target is inside the viewport

claim: Each public route has route-specific title, description, canonical, Open Graph, and Twitter metadata before JavaScript runs.
sandbox: request built HTML for landing, demo, Report Kit, privacy, terms, and 404 without executing JavaScript

claim: Report Kit reads local report JSON and creates a printable cover with three batch labels.
where: Landing paid tier, Report Kit page
sandbox: seed a cached valid fixture license; upload bundled report JSON; assert cover, labels, and no verification request

claim: Report Kit costs $19 once and never gates the core test or report files.
where: Landing paid tier, Report Kit page, README
sandbox: fresh unlicensed browser context; assert $19 purchase copy, Sociobot checkout link, free demo report, and free core-report wording

claim: The site saves a license token only after a visitor adds one.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert no license key on load, add a fixture token, and assert only that key is stored

claim: The browser makes at most one background license check per day and honors Retry-After when the license service limits requests.
sandbox: mock a 429 verification response with Retry-After; assert the browser stores the hold and makes no second request

claim: The site server allows eight license checks per network address in ten minutes, then returns 429 with Retry-After.
sandbox: invoke the server handler nine times for one forwarded client address; assert eight upstream calls followed by 429 and Retry-After
